$comment: What the detector looks for in a photograph (docs/specs/camera-search.md, CS-2; ADR 0062): the shop's categories a photograph can show, each with the words the detector reads in English, and the common objects the shop does not sell, each with its name in es and en for the line under the results. One file for the shop and for the suite that measured it (tools/SearchEval --suite objects). Alternatives are joined by "or": the detector asks each on its own and keeps the best (ObjectKind.Alternatives). Reviewed when a category is added; an object the shop starts selling moves from notSold to sold. The words were measured, not guessed: changing one is running the suite again.

sold.TABLEWARE: plate or bowl or drinking glass
sold.PLANTS: plant pot or planter or houseplant
sold.DECOR: vase or mirror or picture frame

toy.words: teddy bear or doll or figurine
